01 — ABOUT

Behind the wheel

I'm Alex Carter, a creative developer specializing in real-time 3D on the web. I blend engineering with art direction to build immersive experiences — from configurators and data visualizations to full-blown browser games.

My toolkit lives at the intersection of Three.js, WebGL, GLSL shaders, and modern JavaScript. I care about performance budgets as much as I care about how a scene feels at 2am with the lights off.

When I'm not pushing pixels, I'm chasing apexes at the local track — which explains a lot about this website.
